headline: This change will delete and recreate the production database, causing downtime. The one-line description masks the actual impact.

findings.evidence_ref: terraform plan shows actions: [delete, create] with replace_paths: [[storage_encrypted]]; AWS cannot update storage_encrypted in place on RDS instances
findings.explanation: Enabling encryption on an existing RDS instance requires AWS to delete the old database and create a new one. This will cause production downtime, even though Terraform will restore from the final_snapshot. The PR description 'one-line change' does not convey the actual operational impact.
